title: Dubai City Escape

gallery.alt: Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai at dusk
4x4 driving over red dunes on a desert safari
Traditional dhow cruising Dubai Creek at night
White domes of Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi
Dubai Marina skyline over the water

overview: Five days in Dubai with the big sights and time to rest. You stay four nights in a 4-star hotel near Downtown, see the city from the Burj Khalifa, cross the dunes on a desert safari and eat dinner on a dhow along the creek. A day trip to Abu Dhabi and a free final morning for shopping round off the trip. Flights from Lagos, transfers and your UAE visa are handled by our team.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Dubai, dhow cruise dinner
itinerary.description: Your driver meets you at Dubai International and takes you to your hotel near Downtown. In the evening you board a traditional dhow for a buffet dinner along Dubai Creek.

itinerary.title: City tour and Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: A half-day guided tour covers Jumeirah Mosque, the Dubai Frame, the gold and spice souks and an abra ride across the creek. In the afternoon you go up to the Burj Khalifa observation deck on level 124.

itinerary.title: Desert safari
itinerary.description: Free morning. At 3pm a 4x4 picks you up for dune driving, camel riding and sandboarding, followed by a barbecue dinner and live shows at a desert camp.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, dinner · Stay: 4-star hotel, Downtown

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi day trip
itinerary.description: Drive to Abu Dhabi to visit Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Qasr Al Watan and the Corniche, with a photo stop at Ferrari World.

itinerary.title: Shopping and departure
itinerary.description: Free morning for Dubai Mall or Mall of the Emirates. Your driver takes you to the airport for your flight back to Lagos.

included: 4 nights in a 4-star hotel with breakfast

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. Nigerian passport holders need a UAE visa. We process it for you as part of the package once you send your documents.
Yes. We can quote 3-star, 5-star or beachfront options. Tell us on WhatsApp and we update your quote.

faqs.q: Can I travel on other dates?
faqs.a: Yes. The listed dates are group departures. Private trips can start on any date, subject to flight and hotel availability.
The price is a starting price per person, sharing a room. Your final quote on WhatsApp reflects your dates, flights and room type.
